alternatives.description: Keep gate and conformance receipts as independent CI artifacts without tamper-evident linkage.
alternatives.projected_effect: Receipts remain visible but deletion/reordering/substitution across a run is not mechanically detectable.
alternatives.risk: Audit continuity remains a declared FRONTIER.

alternatives.description: Add deterministic content hashes and append-only predecessor linkage over emitted governance receipts.
alternatives.projected_effect: A run can verify ordering, substitution and omission boundaries without granting new authority.
alternatives.risk: CI artifact retention is still bounded and external protected storage remains future work.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING cannot detect receipt-chain tamper or reordering.
Hash chaining adds maintenance and does not by itself make GitHub artifact retention permanent.

assumptions: Audit evidence cannot authorize an action.
Content hashing plus predecessor linkage is a bounded tamper-evidence mechanism, not permanent archival certification.
reason.uncertainty: CI artifact retention is time-bounded; protected external archival remains outside this slice.
counterexamples: Changing a chained receipt body must invalidate its hash.
Reordering entries must invalidate predecessor linkage.
A REJECT/ESCALATE receipt must remain admissible audit evidence rather than disappear because the workflow fails.
reason.conclusion: Implement a non-authorizing deterministic audit chain only if unit tests, conformance checks and the existing trusted ActionGate pass without changing canonical Garden or authority roots.

obligations.statement: Audit entry content tampering is detected by deterministic hash recomputation.
Deletion/reordering breaks predecessor linkage or expected sequence count.
Gate and WP-009 conformance receipts are chained and persisted before fail-closed enforcement.
Audit receipts cannot mint authority, approval, proof or canonical promotion.

items.claim_scope: Garden preserves immutable provenance for material state evolution.
